name: AURAPOL s.r.o.
summary: Czech filament manufacturer headquartered in Sumna, South Moravia, extruding since 2017-18 and marketing heavily on Czech-made provenance. A second production facility in Andrychow, Poland was added in 2025. The range is mainstream and price-aggressive: PLA in many variants (including a high-temperature HT110 grade, wood-filled and recycled), PET-G, ASA and ABS.

product_lines.name: AURAPOL PLA HT110
product_lines.notes: Annealable high-temperature PLA; the '110' refers to the claimed post-annealing service temperature.

product_lines.name: AURAPOL PLA Recycled
product_lines.notes: Recycled-feedstock PLA; same chemistry as base PLA, no recycled-content id exists.

product_lines.name: AURAPOL PET-G (incl. Army and Recycled)
product_lines.notes: Standard PETG plus matte 'Army' colourway and a recycled-feedstock variant; one chemistry.

additional_notes: Pricing roughly USD 13-17/kg, positioning it at the budget end of EU-made filament. The Polish facility (Andrychow, 2025) is the second site; both are counted in manufacturing_countries because extrusion, not just warehousing, is claimed for each.

provenance.conflicts: The Polish site's role (full extrusion vs finishing/logistics) is asserted by the company and not independently confirmed.
